strategy.summary: Strengthen test/pricing.test.js so the 6 surviving mutants in src/pricing.js are killed: assert exact return values where tests only ran code, and add boundary cases at $50 (free shipping), $100 (coupon threshold) and an orderTotal where shipping is non-zero. Existing tests and assertions are kept; expected values come from the JSDoc and README rules, not from running the code.
inScope: applyCoupon return values (no coupon, other code, small order, $100 boundary)
orderTotal for an order that pays shipping
outOfScope: The 2 mutants no test reaches (formatPrice), per the work item
Restructuring existing tests beyond adding assertions
assumptions: README and JSDoc agree with the code on every rule asserted: free shipping from $50 inclusive, $4.99 below; SAVE20 only over $100 (exclusive); total = discounted + shipping, rounded to the cent.

risks.description: Floating point totals (e.g. 20 + 4.99) could mismatch exact equality
risks.mitigation: orderTotal rounds to the cent; expected 24.99 is the rounded value and asserted with toBe.

acceptanceCriteria.text: applyCoupon returns the subtotal unchanged when no coupon or a code other than SAVE20 is given, even for a subtotal over $100
applyCoupon with SAVE20 leaves a subtotal of $100 or less unchanged (only over $100 is discounted)
shippingCost is free for a subtotal of exactly $50
orderTotal adds the $4.99 shipping to an order under $50

testCases.title: handles an order without a coupon
testCases.expected: Returns 200 (existing test strengthened with an assertion)
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 1 (condition -> true) and mutant 2 (&& -> ||): both would discount to 160.

testCases.title: leaves a large order unchanged with a code other than SAVE20
testCases.rationale: Pins 'any other code changes nothing'; also kills mutants 1 and 2 (left side false, right side true).

testCases.title: handles a small order with the coupon
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 4 (subtotal > 100 -> true) and mutant 1: both would return 40.

testCases.title: does not discount an order of exactly $100 with SAVE20
ships an order of exactly $50 for free
adds shipping to the total of a small order
testCases.rationale: Kills mutant 6 (+ shipping -> - shipping), which would return 15.01; the existing case has free shipping so can't tell.

strategy.environmentNotes: None; pure unit tests run with `npm test` (vitest run).
